subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently replace the standalone Talk destination with Chat as the single text-and-voice conversation surface, including redirecting the existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases to Chat?
rationale: The implementation is substantial and proof-backed, but choosing the canonical mobile navigation and upgrade behavior is a maintainer product decision that cannot be inferred from test results alone.

options.title: Approve unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversation surface and keep the alias routing as the supported upgrade path after owner sign-off.

options.title: Retain a separate Talk destination
options.body: Keep the existing Talk navigation contract and request a narrower branch that preserves it while carrying only independently desired session-safety work.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversation surface and keep the alias routing as the supported upgrade path after owner sign-off.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR review workflow explicitly routed the unresolved navigation and upgrade decision to this participant.
